summary_en: 5,464,400 shares (8.34% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-24 at ¥5,490/share. Single execution window, time-limited order. Block portion of ¥30B program authorized 2026-08-20 (6,910,000 shares authorized at 10.55% S/O over 2026-08-24 to 2026-08-26).
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading
translation_en_brief: LINTEC Corporation announced on 2026-08-21 the execution of a block repurchase via ToSTNeT-3 (off-hours trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange). The company will acquire up to 5,464,400 ordinary shares (8.34% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) at the closing price of ¥5,490 per share on a single-execution basis at 08:45 JST on 2026-08-24. The order is time-limited to that specific market window. This block execution is part of a board-authorized program approved 2026-08-20 permitting acquisition of up to 6,910,000 shares (10.55% of S/O) for a maximum outlay of ¥30 billion over the period 2026-08-24 to 2026-08-26, also via ToSTNeT-3. The company notes that execution of additional blocks (if any) under the broader authorization will be separately announced in advance. Market conditions may result in partial or non-execution of any block.
